title: ATS webhook signature validation failing - 401 Unauthorized

error_signal.message: vocator-backend 401 Unauthorized: validateWebhookSignature HMAC signature mismatch on ATS webhook endpoint

ground_truth.root_cause_description: Webhook signing secret was rotated on the ATS provider side but not updated in environment variables. Configuration mismatch.
ground_truth.fix_description: Update the ATS webhook signing secret in environment variables to match the provider's new secret
